slides: Welcome back, and now we're starting a new topic, percentages. Percent questions come up in almost every exam. They also come up inside chart questions and other word problems.

slides.say: And honestly, you already know more than you think. Everybody knows that fifty percent off means half price. Today we'll make that feeling exact, and fast.
So what is a percent? A percent is a way to describe a part of something. It's just like a fraction.
One hundred percent is the whole. The whole class, the whole price, the whole bottle.
at: One hundred percent is the whole

slides.say: So one percent is one hundredth of the whole. If we cut the whole into a hundred equal parts, one percent is one of those parts.
at: So one percent is one hundredth

slides: Look at the percent sign itself. It has a small circle, a slash, and another small circle. It looks like a fraction, a number over a number. And that's exactly what it means, something over a hundred.

slides.say: So twenty-nine percent is twenty-nine over a hundred. Twenty-nine parts out of a hundred.
Careful here. A percent alone is not an amount. It's always a percent of something. So we always ask, a percent of what?
Twenty-nine percent of a hundred tickets is twenty-nine tickets. But twenty-nine percent of two hundred tickets is twice that. Two times twenty-nine is fifty-eight tickets.
at: Twenty-nine percent of a hundred tickets
But twenty-nine percent of two hundred

slides.say: Now let's go from a percent to a fraction. It's simple. We write the percent over a hundred, and then we reduce.
Fifty percent is fifty over a hundred. Fifty and a hundred both divide by fifty. So it's one over two, one half. Half price, just as we said.
Thirty percent is thirty over a hundred. Both divide by ten, so it's three over ten, three tenths.
One more. Sixty-four percent is sixty-four over a hundred. Both divide by four.
Sixty-four divided by four is sixteen. A hundred divided by four is twenty-five. So sixty-four percent is sixteen over twenty-five.
at: Sixty-four divided by four is sixteen
A hundred divided by four is twenty-five

slides.say: Now the other way, from a fraction to a percent. We expand the fraction until the bottom is a hundred. Then the top is the percent.
Let's take eleven over twenty-five. How do we get from twenty-five to a hundred? Twenty-five times four is a hundred.
So we multiply the top by four too. Eleven times four is forty-four. That's forty-four over a hundred, forty-four percent.
Why can we multiply the top and the bottom by the same number? Because the fraction stays the same. We just cut it into smaller pieces.
Another one, seven over fifty. Fifty times two is a hundred. So the top is also times two. Seven times two is fourteen, so it's fourteen percent.
And three over twenty. Twenty times five is a hundred. Three times five is fifteen. So three over twenty is fifteen percent. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next part.
